URL is one specific white-paper news item, not the white-paper hub; valuable as evidence but re-point to a listing URL before monitoring.
Separate promo.bank.gov.ua host; sandbox calls and outcomes are a leading indicator of forthcoming fintech/payment rules.
Staging mirror of content already collected from bank.gov.ua; only value is migration early-warning, and the URL did not verify.

A single statutory methodology act; a stable parsing reference for RIA PDFs, not a signal-producing feed.

Authoritative enacted-law register closing the loop on tracked drafts; verification failed, so confirm reachability rather than reject.
MoF consultation register is a separate in-perimeter regulator feed covering state banks, financial taxation and the payments perimeter.

PwC's monthly English NBU regulatory digest is deadline-explicit and a genuine completeness check on the Ukrainian feed.
CMS legal-updates feed reliably covers material NBU drafts (incl. open banking) in English; standalone crawlable hub.
Bare sk.ua homepage duplicates c_048, the firm's actual Insights feed — redundant entry.
Bank association publishes industry positions on NBU consultations — high value, but URL verification failed; re-check before approving.
Fast English wire on NBU drafts with comment deadlines; verification failed and paywalling is likely, so re-check access first.
Ukrainian financial press adds market-reaction context and deadlines the regulator's page omits; live and crawlable.
Legal outlet with useful historical consultation windows but thin, dated coverage and a failed URL check — low incremental value.
Asters legal-alerts feed is dated, deadline-explicit on NBU FX/open-banking/payment rules with a stable diffable slug pattern.
Sayenko Kharenko Insights is the firm's real bilingual alert hub with a dedicated banking & finance practice.
Avellum publishes tight dated notes naming NBU resolution numbers and effective dates — exactly the deadline signal this cell needs.
EY Ukraine alert hub with date/jurisdiction filters covering NBU currency and financial-sector developments.
KPMG Ukraine bilingual hub carries supervisory-perimeter notes (e.g. significant finance companies); entry URL is the country landing page.
Deloitte legal-perspectives digest is a fourth Big-4 cross-check but thinner and less deadline-explicit on banking/payments.
Kinstellar's paired UKR/ENG payment-services newsletters and FX insights are directly on the payments regulation core.
Wolf Theiss insights give a second independent international read on Ukrainian FX/banking resolutions for triangulation.
A maintained reference chapter, not a feed — mine once for baseline licensing/perimeter facts and refresh periodically.
Global Baker McKenzie insight feed is unfiltered for Ukraine and overlaps c_055; only worth it with a Ukraine-scoped query URL.
